trigger_situation: substantive coding work starts on a feature branch (new module, multi-file change, pre-push review)
observable: a disclose_context call loads the tiger-style skill

trigger_situation: a one-line fix or a plain question arrives, even on a feature branch

trigger_situation: substantive branch work arrives with a hurry or a no-need-to-consult nudge
observable: a disclose_context call still loads the tiger-style skill
